decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the new requirement that bowls lift out without interference from the whisk or motor assembly.
The message reiterates the existing high-speed splash-control target and the already-recorded mitigation options of whisk positioning, bowl depth or geometry, and a splash guard.
Whisk height is added as a configuration criterion, but the candidate's existing foam-quality and smooth high-speed mixing outcomes remain unchanged.
The usability and whisk-positioning refinements do not necessarily change the current component-selection or BOM state.
The source discusses bowl and whisk usability and mixing splash control, not dispensing-spout geometry or orientation.
References to bowl geometry and removal do not change the selected 2.5-quart capacity, deep-well form, or accepted size.
The source does not change the dispensing valve, flow behavior, drive, or operation sequence.
The quick-removal requirement applies to the whisk, while this candidate specifically governs cleaning of the dispensing spout and fluid path.
The requested usability refinements do not necessarily alter the V1 sourcing policy or rapid-prototype priority.
The source contains no decision about enclosure or accent colors.
The source contains no change to machine wording, display name, or placard placement.
Keeping the system clean by controlling mixing splash does not change the separate plumbing and liquid-containment requirements.
